title: N66: Bootstrap CI for key statistics — GJR advantage 99.7% certain, CI excludes zero
description: Ran 5000 bootstrap replications for SPY 2023-2024 (501 OOS days). Key results: GJR QLIKE improvement -0.45% [-0.78%, -0.14%] — CI excludes zero. Probability GJR better: 99.7%. DM significant at 5% in 78.5% of resamples. Mean gamma 0.108 [0.105, 0.111] — tightly estimated above 0.10. 40% of windows show gamma<0.10 — the model selection rule correctly handles within-sample variation. These CIs could be added to the paper to strengthen the statistical claims.
